title: Knowledge Cache State
description: UC7KS knowledge cache state — tracks cache health, agent compliance, and pipeline bypass attempts. Added Phase 4 hardening (FW-HARDEN-UC7KS).

cache_status.description: Overall health status of the local knowledge cache.

last_index_check.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last time index.json was verified.

last_fetch_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent @Knowledge-Curator fetch.

total_bypass_attempts.description: Total number of bypass attempts (direct external queries without cache check).

bypass_attempts_by_agent.description: Bypass attempts keyed by agent type.

cache_hits.description: Number of times agents successfully used cached docs.

cache_misses.description: Number of times agents needed docs not in cache.

pipeline_integrity.description: Integrity verification of the knowledge pipeline.

verified_count.description: Number of cache files verified in last integrity check.

mismatch_count.description: Number of hash mismatches found in last integrity check.

session_access.description: UC7-001 per-agent cache access tracking. Records when each agent type last read docs/official_docs/index.json. Used by compliance_gate_check and uc7ks-enforcer to enforce the 'local-first' mandate. Keyed by agent type (e.g. '@Super-Admin', '@Coder-BE'). Added FW-HARDEN-UC7KS-001.

last_read_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent cache index read.

last_file_read.description: Last cache file path that was read (e.g., 'docs/official_docs/index.json').

uc7_001_compliant.description: Whether this agent has satisfied UC7-001 (read local cache before proceeding).

total_cache_reads.description: Total number of times this agent has read cache files.

declared_scope.description: Agent's declared module domain from knowledge_semantic_map (e.g., 'backend_api', 'persistence'). Set by module_scope_declare tool. FW-HARDEN-UC7KS-002.

declared_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the agent declared its module scope.

cache_sufficiency.description: Agent's cache sufficiency declaration. UC7-001 READ-BEFORE-WRITE HARDEN (2026-06-18): discovery (machine-generated by knowledge_cache_search) is required; attestation (agent-submitted via knowledge_cache_attest) is the AUTHORITATIVE read evidence in strict/locked mode. Legacy fields (status, reason, files_read, content_summary) are DEPRECATED as write-block evidence — only for display/compat.

status.description: LEGACY: Overall cache sufficiency. Deprecated as authoritative write-block evidence. Use discovery.status instead.

reason.description: LEGACY/DEPRECATED: Auto-generated by knowledge_cache_search. NOT authoritative read evidence. Use attestation.reason for verified read attestation.

files_read.description: LEGACY/DEPRECATED: Auto-populated from index.json entries. NOT verified against read_audit.jsonl. Use attestation.files_read for cross-verified read evidence.

content_summary.description: LEGACY/DEPRECATED: Auto-generated summary. NOT verified. Use attestation.content_summary for agent-written verified summary.

missing_topics.description: Specific topics the agent found missing in cache.

declared_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when sufficiency was declared.

discovery.description: PHASE 0 NEW (2026-06-18): Machine-generated cache coverage discovery. Written by knowledge_cache_search tool. Records what the cache CONTAINS — not what was read. Required before attestation.

status.description: Whether matching cache entries were found.

discovered_files.description: Cache file paths from index.json that match the domain (relative to docs/official_docs/). These files EXIST — agent may or may not have read them.

discovered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when discovery was performed.

attestation.description: PHASE 0 NEW (2026-06-18): Agent-submitted read evidence. Written by knowledge_cache_attest tool after cross-verification against read_audit.jsonl. In strict/locked mode, this is the ONLY authoritative source for UC7-001 write-block decisions. attestation.status='attested' means: (1) discovery.sufficient, (2) files_read ⊆ discovered_files, (3) all files verified in read_audit.jsonl, (4) reason/content_summary non-empty.

status.description: Read evidence status. 'attested' = verified by attest tool. 'pending' = discovered but not yet attested (default for legacy data). 'skipped' = agent explicitly skipped attest. 'legacy_discovered_only' = auto-migrated legacy sufficient without verification.

reason.description: Agent-written reason for reading these specific cache files.

files_read.description: Cache file paths the agent ACTUALLY read (verified against read_audit.jsonl). Must be subset of discovery.discovered_files.

content_summary.description: Agent-written summary of what was learned from the read files.

attested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when attestation was performed.
